findings.text: The bean defines five acceptance criteria (tasks) while the size_budget limits `max_tasks` to **4**. This exceeds the allowed task count.
The bean defines six acceptance criteria (tasks) but its size_budget caps `max_tasks` at **4**, so it exceeds the allowed number of tasks.
Acceptance criterion `ac5` does not include a `verify` field, making it impossible to automatically verify that this AC is satisfied as required by the definition of done.
The bean defines five acceptance criteria (tasks) whereas the size_budget permits only **4** tasks, violating the task‑count limit.
